summary: Feed c091_span is degraded: SPAN destination CORE-SW-01 Gi1/0/48 is oversubscribed (1.35 Gbps mirrored into 1 Gbps port) causing 26.04% packet loss (2.64M discards). IDS is missing over a quarter of traffic.

findings.root_cause: SPAN oversubscription and buffer exhaustion at CORE-SW-01 Gi1/0/48: SPAN session should copy 10,140,000 packets (1.35 Gbps) from CORE-SW-01 Gi1/0/1 but destination only sent 7,500,000, discarding 2,640,000 packets on output at 100% load (bursts higher). SPAN destination port speed (1 Gbps) is insufficient for mirrored rate.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS misses ~26% of packets/flows. With needs_both_directions=true and needs_full_payload=true, loss creates one-sided flows, broken reassembly, and missed signatures - intrusions can evade detection and alerts will be incomplete/false-negative.

params.note: 1.35 Gbps exceeds IDS 1 Gbps port - also plan filtering, load balancing or tool upgrade after TAP insertion

recommended_fix.why: SPAN copies in software/buffer and drops when ingress exceeds destination capacity or on bursts. A passive TAP provides lossless line-rate copy independent of switch load, ensuring complete traffic delivery required for IDS detection coverage.
